name: googlefindmytoolswebui-assets
description: Build-time only: minifies webui/static/*.css|js and vendors htmx/Leaflet/fonts locally instead of a CDN. Never installed in the runtime image - see docker/web/Dockerfile's assets stage.

scripts.build:js: esbuild webui/static/app.js webui/static/tables.js webui/static/endpoint_fields.js webui/static/firmware.js webui/static/provision.js webui/static/debug_export.js --minify --outdir=webui/static/dist
scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
